channel.title: Astrofray | Devlog & Updates
channel.description: Official devlogs, patch notes, and Closed Preview announcements for Astrofray by Ezrok Studios.

item.title: Version 0.4.1 Live: Performance Optimizations, Multi-Monitor Support & Onboarding Polish
item.description:
Astrofray v0.4.1 has landed with performance enhancements, multi-monitor display flexibility, and onboarding polish:

  • Performance & Frame Pacing: Substantially reduced garbage collection overhead during high-density combat by replacing coroutines with float timers, pooling shader properties, and optimizing UI Toolkit updates.
  • Multi-Monitor Display Selector: Added a dedicated monitor switcher in Settings allowing seamless display targeting across multi-monitor PC setups.
  • In-Combat Onboarding Overlay: Sector 1 now introduces an adaptive controls banner automatically tuned for keyboard and gamepad users to get new pilots up to speed fast.
  • Save Compatibility: Fully compatible with v0.4.0 savegame progress.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 Live: Tactical Dashing, Physics Asteroids, Scrap Economy & New Bosses
item.description:
Astrofray v0.4.0 is now live for the Closed Preview with massive new mechanics and architectural overhauls:

⚠️ Progress Reset Note: Due to major progression re-architecting, save data from v0.3 versions has been reset.

  • Tactical Thruster Dash: Slip through dense bullet curtains and evade swarms with a split-second evasive boost.
  • Dynamic Physics Asteroids: Utilize drifting asteroids as kinetic cover against incoming fire, or fracture them into hazards.
  • Scrap Economy & Armory Purchasing: Collect salvage scrap from fallen hostiles to purchase upgrades and modules.
  • New Enemies & Dreadnought Bosses: Encounter brand-new hostile ship variants and intense multi-phase boss battles.
  • Audiovisual Polish & New Music: Fresh high-energy combat tracks, improved neon weapon VFX, and punchy impact feedback.
  • Rebalancing & Engine: Full combat rebalancing, frame pacing optimizations for heavy bullet counts, and stability crash fixes.

item.title: Version 0.3.2 Live: Overhauled Boss Explosions & Target Tracking
item.description:
Astrofray v0.3.2 has been deployed with key combat feedback improvements:

  • Reworked Boss Explosions: Dreadnought takedowns are now significantly punchier with overhauled visual FX and shockwaves.
  • Off-Screen Target Indicators: Dynamic chevron markers point toward out-of-view hostiles so you never lose the fight.
  • Performance & Polish: Frame-rate optimizations for dense bullet curtains and minor bug fixes.

item.title: Version 0.3.1 Live: Combat Polish & Mid-Battle Settings
item.description:
Update v0.3.1 brings quality-of-life adjustments:

  • Better Combat Visuals: Revamped space backdrop and clearer hit feedback upon taking hull damage.
  • Mid-Combat Settings: Adjust audio, controls, and display options directly from the in-combat pause menu.
  • Combat Resume Fix: Resolved an edge-case bug where resuming a saved encounter prematurely triggered victory.
